segments.title: Chasing the Wind
segments.description: A red-orange leaf-shaped kite escapes from a LEGO child's hand. The child, a LEGO minifigure, runs across a lively pumpkin patch, weaving between oversized pumpkins and hay bales. The kite dances through the wind just out of reach.

segments.title: Lost in the Maze
segments.description: The kite swoops into a giant leaf maze. The LEGO child pauses at the entrance, unsure which way to go. Birds fly overhead as orange leaves swirl around. The camera slowly pulls up to reveal the entire maze shaped like a maple leaf.
segments.style: Soft breeze, golden hour, playful composition

segments.title: Kite Reborn at Sunset
segments.description: On top of a grassy hill at sunset, the LEGO child finds the torn kite. Using LEGO bricks and fallen leaves, they rebuild it creatively. The final shot shows the kite soaring high across the vivid sunset sky as the camera zooms out.
segments.style: Cinematic, backlit with long shadows, emotional
